tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
UGREEN US132 USB 2.0 A Male to Mini USB Cable – 1.5m High-Speed Sync & Charge

The UGREEN US132 (10385) is a high-quality USB 2.0 Type-A Male to Mini USB 5-Pin Male cable, measuring 1.5 meters in length. Designed for efficient data transfer and device charging, it supports a data transfer rate of up to 480 Mbps. This cable is ideal for connecting older digital devices such as cameras, MP3 players, GPS units, and gaming controllers to your computer or USB-enabled charger.


Key Features:

  • Connector Type: USB 2.0 Type-A Male to Mini USB 5-Pin Male
  • Cable Length: 1.5 meters
  • Data Transfer Speed: Up to 480 Mbps
  • Durability: Supports over 10,000 bend and insertion cycles
  • Build Quality: Gold-plated connectors resist corrosion and improve signal quality
  • Shielding: Foil and braided shielding for stable, interference-free performance
  • Plug-and-Play: No drivers required; compatible with Windows, macOS, and Linux systems
  • Compatible Devices: GoPro HERO HD/HERO3+, PS3 controllers, Canon and Nikon digital cameras, Garmin GPS units, MP3/MP4 players, Scanner and many more.
